patterns.note: Content is presented in centered, max-width containers within full-width sections, often with subtle background shifts or abstract gradient overlays.

A vibrant primary blue (#3784ff) is consistently used as an accent for interactive elements, key text highlights, and abstract illustrations, providing a strong contrast against a predominantly white and light grey background.

Sections reveal dynamically as the user scrolls, with content sliding up from the bottom and fading in as it enters the viewport. The hero section's main content also slides up and out of view on scroll.
Abstract, soft gradient 'cloud' shapes are frequently used as background elements, often framing or containing UI examples and key information, giving a modern and ethereal feel.
Large, clean sans-serif headings are used for impact, with specific keywords within headings often highlighted in the primary accent blue to draw attention to core concepts.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered animations using CSS keyframes to reveal content sections. Elements should slide up from below the viewport and fade in simultaneously as they become visible. The hero section's primary text and illustration should animate upwards and fade out as the user scrolls down, while the main navigation and a floating action button remain fixed in place.
Utilize soft, blurred gradient shapes as background elements, often with a subtle animation or parallax effect on scroll, to create visual depth and frame content without hard edges.
Employ a consistent grid system for displaying features, logos, and multi-column content, ensuring even spacing and alignment across different section types.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger than body text, with the hero heading being approximately 3-4x the body size, maintaining a clean sans-serif with medium to semi-bold weights.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on cards, buttons, and input fields (~8-12px)
design_tokens.spacing: airy, especially in hero and between major sections, with balanced density within feature grids and card layouts

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its consistent use of abstract, soft gradient 'cloud' shapes as background elements. These shapes often frame or contain UI examples, creating an ethereal yet modern aesthetic that elevates the design beyond typical SaaS marketing templates.
